scope: Bounded single-CN direct-key preaggregation omission. Synthetic validation, not ClickBench closure or distributed speedup.

environment.note: Shared external diagnostic fixture overlays only; production configuration and owners unchanged. No claim about a 32MiB total statement cap.

setup_sql: create table big(k bigint unsigned,s varchar(40),hot bigint unsigned)

insert into big select result % 3000000, case when (result % 3000000) % 97=0 then null when (result % 3000000) % 89=0 then '' else concat('key-',cast(result % 3000000 as char)) end,result % 10000 from generate_series(1,6000000)g
insert into small select result%500000 from generate_series(1,1000000)g
reproduction.matching_build: BASE overlay replaces only compile.go with the frozen target version; both binaries use identical diagnostic source, fixture overlays, native library, toolchain, build flags and data generation. Compiler tests are not linked into SQL integration binaries.

public_execution.prepared_sql: select count(distinct k) from big where k<?
